---
description: Rules for the SDLC deliverables in docs/ and for Markdown files.
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---
- Use the deliverable filenames from the workflow: `docs/requirements.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/design-review.md`, `docs/impl-plan.md`, `docs/code-review.md`, `docs/verification-report.md`.
- Keep each document traceable: refer to requirement IDs, architecture components, and task IDs rather than repeating text.
- Mark assumptions and open questions explicitly. Do not present them as facts.
- Use Mermaid for diagrams.
